packageRules.description: TypeScript is held at 6.x on purpose. TS 7's native compiler ships without a stable programmatic API, so typescript-eslint cannot read the AST and ESLint crashes on startup. Re-enable when TS 7.1 lands that API.
Playwright's runner, browsers and system libraries move together — one PR, not three.
Same for the lint toolchain, which has to stay mutually compatible.
Everything else non-major in one weekly PR, so the queue stays short.
